questions.title: Which national team will win the third-place playoff at the 2026 FIFA Men's World Cup?
questions.background: The third-place playoff is contested by the two teams eliminated in the semifinals.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official result for the 2026 Men's World Cup third-place playoff. Resolution : Resolve to the winner of the third-place playoff, scheduled for July 18, 2026, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.
questions.current_reasoning: Spain's 3-0 rout of Austria on July 2 drives a clear jump and #2 ranking flip in the third-place playoff (Match 103): Spain's Reach-Semifinal probability surges from ~40% to ~48.6% while frequently meeting Elo favorite France in SF1, sending Spain into the bronze match ~23% of the time as heavy favorites and lifting Spain +2.5% from 12.0% to 14.5% (Pure-Results 14.3%, Base 15.0%, Market 15.2%, Conservative 13.7%) to clearly overtake Argentina (12.0%). Simultaneously, a stronger, locked-in Spain is more likely to upset France in SF1 and drop France into the third-place match (where France wins ~70%), lifting France +1.0% from 15.5% to 16.5% (ensemble 16.1%-17.1%). England nudges 8.5% -> 9.0% (ensemble 8.3%-9.5%) and Brazil holds 8.0%, leaving 40.0% for Portugal (~5.3%), Colombia (~5.0%), Morocco (~5.0%), Norway, and the field.

Al Jazeera tells you everything about Canada vs Morocco: How did Canada and Morocco reach the Round of 16? Canada came second in Group B with four points, securing a win over Qatar and a draw with Bosnia and Herzegovina. They lost to Switzerland in the final group game. The Canadians beat South Africa 1-0 in the round of 32. Morocco were second in Group C with seven points, winning against Scotland and Haiti, and holding Brazil to a draw.
